run.title: Spline FA on the 10% grid, ε 10%
run.what_changed: Spline function approximation (909 features, l2 = 0, greedy refresh every 100) on the 10% grid (43,758 portfolios) with B = 63, 26M episodes and grid10-robustness's seeds, at the noise-matched alpha = 2.78e-5 (EXPERIMENTS.md §8.8). ε at halfway 10% instead of 3%; otherwise identical to fa-spline-grid10-eps3.
